comments.comment: RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: interactive code 29 collects unreserved actors and person targets that remain eligible under the current force context.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: interactive code 30 collects unreserved actors and eligible hostile region-building targets through the shared burn predicate.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: interactive code 31 reuses the burn building-domain gates and additionally requires the target force to have positive funds.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: interactive code 32 selects two distinct eligible forces, requires the first target force to contain at least two people, then collects unreserved actors.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: automatic alienate passes the shared action gate, selects an eligible force/person target and actor, and converges on the interactive command.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: automatic burn passes the shared action gate, selects an eligible target, origin and actor, and converges on the interactive command.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: automatic seize follows the same target/origin/actor pipeline as burn with the added positive-funds target gate, then converges on the interactive command.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: automatic gossip selects an eligible two-force pair, then an origin and actor, and converges on the interactive command.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: alienate submission reserves participants and stores a stable rnd(100) roll in a type-29 event; it deducts no funds, food or troops.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: burn submission reserves participants and stores a stable rnd(100) roll in a type-30 event; it deducts no funds, food or troops.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: seize submission reserves participants and stores a stable rnd(100) roll in a type-31 event; it deducts no funds, food or troops.
RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: gossip submission reserves participants and stores a stable rnd(100) roll plus both target forces in a type-32 event; it deducts no funds, food or troops.

RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: alienate succeeds iff stored_roll < live formula-3 threshold; success passes -(4-target_raw_0x70/5+rnd(3)) to the loyalty adjuster, attempts actor intelligence growth and changes force relations, while failure only changes relations. Both branches finish with strategy proficiency and common cleanup.

RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: burn succeeds iff stored_roll < live formula-8 threshold; success damages durability by formula 13, has a separate 3% food-loss branch and attempts actor war growth. Failure injures the actor and changes force relations. Both branches finish with strategy proficiency and common cleanup.

RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: seize uses one stored roll against ordered item, person and money thresholds; first matching branch wins. Money transfer is capped by target funds and formula 12; no match injures the actor and changes force relations.

RE-SAN9PK-0115 [confirmed]: gossip succeeds iff stored_roll < live formula-4 threshold; success reduces relation between the two target forces, may raise a selected target person's loyalty, and attempts actor intelligence growth. Failure changes actor-side force relations. Both branches finish with strategy proficiency and common cleanup.
